title: Backup actions
loadFailed: Unable to check backup actions. Refresh to try again.
hold: Backup pruning is on hold after this restore. New snapshots continue, but none are pruned until the owner confirms the old server is gone.
ownerOnly: Ask the owner to confirm after the old server is shut down.
review: Confirm the old server is gone
confirmDescription: Shut down the old server first. Confirming lets this install prune snapshots in the shared backup bucket again.
confirmCheck: The old server is shut down and will not run again.
confirmFailed: Unable to confirm. Refresh the settings and try again.
running: Your backup is running. You can leave this page.
failed: Your backup failed. Check backup settings and System health before trying again.
notConfigured: Set up backups before taking a snapshot.
alreadyRunning: A backup is already queued or running.
alreadyFinished: This backup request already finished. Refresh before taking a new backup.
unavailable: A restore is in progress or backups are unavailable on this install.
requestFailed: Unable to confirm the backup request. Check its status, then retry; retrying this request will not queue another backup.
